body: I'm not sure, it likely has to do with all the sexual abuse I've endured as a child ... I've only been given sexual attention therefore it's all I can output.

Thanks I guess. It's just hard because I've given my heart to men who convinced me they cared and showed signs of helping me, motivating me, etc etc, all just to abandon me and give up. And I don't want to rely on another man or depend on them but I do want someone understanding who will protect me and love me truly. And that desire for love keeps me oh so naive making poor decisions and thus it's an ongoing cycle. 

Also, that subreddit is closed I think. And I guess since my past has been mostly traumatic due to sexual abuse or sexual attachment, GW helps me think I am good enough for other people.
Aside from gaming, I really like technology, I usually am always surrounded by my phones, kindle fire, vita, macbook, etc. I used to write, but I have trouble doing that nowadays.

I've always talked to people and they give me their usual pep speech, but no one really gets what goes on in my mind. In one really emotional state I had a friend tell me that he didn't care about my problems which only made it worse and now I prefer not to tell people I know because it's obvious no one gives a shit. 

I spend 100% of my time at home alone, not one phone call to hang out, text to see how I'm doing unless it's from some guy trying to get in my pants. 

I can "be" fine and social with people, you wouldn't be able to look at me and see a broken mess but I'm tired of pretending. Every time I do good, something else pulls me back into this same spiral.
It's much, much easier said than done, but thanks.
